description: This file contains classes and methods for handling OAuth 1.0 authentication, including signature methods, request handling, token management, and utility functions, specifically for Twitter OAuth integration.

classes.name: OAuthException
classes.description: Custom exception class for OAuth errors.

classes.name: OAuthConsumer
classes.description: Represents an OAuth consumer with key and secret.

classes.name: OAuthToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth token, including methods for serialization.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod
classes.description: Abstract class for implementing different OAuth signature methods.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod_HMAC_SHA1
classes.description: Implements HMAC-SHA1 signature method for OAuth.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod_PLAINTEXT
classes.description: Implements PLAINTEXT signature method for OAuth.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod_RSA_SHA1
classes.description: Abstract class for RSA-SHA1 signature method, requiring key fetch implementations.

classes.name: OAuthRequest
classes.description: Handles OAuth request creation, parameter management, and signature generation.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Manages OAuth token requests, verification, and signature validation.

classes.name: OAuthDataStore
classes.description: Interface for data storage and retrieval of consumers, tokens, and nonces.

classes.name: OAuthUtil
classes.description: Utility functions for encoding, header parsing, parameter parsing, and URL building.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the signature method (abstract).

methods.name: build_signature
methods.description: Builds the signature for a request (abstract).

methods.name: check_signature
methods.description: Verifies if a signature is correct.

methods.name: get_signature_base_string
methods.description: Generates the base string for signing.

methods.name: sign_request
methods.description: Signs the OAuth request with a signature method.

methods.name: build_signature
methods.description: Builds the signature using a specified signature method.

methods.name: from_request
methods.description: Creates an OAuthRequest object from server variables and headers.

methods.name: from_consumer_and_token
methods.description: Creates an OAuthRequest with consumer and token info.

methods.name: set_parameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter in the request.

methods.name: get_normalized_http_method
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method in uppercase.

methods.name: to_url
methods.description: Returns the full URL with parameters.

methods.name: sign_request
methods.description: Signs the request with a signature method, consumer, and token.

methods.name: build_signature
methods.description: Builds the signature for the request.

methods.name: add_signature_method
methods.description: Adds a signature method to the OAuth server.

methods.name: get_consumer
methods.description: Retrieves consumer info based on key.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Retrieves token info based on key.

methods.name: check_signature
methods.description: Checks the validity of a signature.
